Run video tracking for a target segment.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --seg-id, --follower-seg-id TEXT 
                              Follower segment id that receives the tracked surface motion
          --source-seg-id TEXT 
                              Source video segment id to track (maps to target_seg)
          --tracker-type TEXT Tracking type: 1 motion tracking (default), 2 surface tracking
          --center-x TEXT     Motion tracking box center x in canvas coordinates (required for
                              tracker type 1)
          --center-y TEXT     Motion tracking box center y in canvas coordinates (required for
                              tracker type 1)
          --width TEXT        Motion tracking box width in canvas coordinates (required for
                              tracker type 1)
          --height TEXT       Motion tracking box height in canvas coordinates (required for
                              tracker type 1)
          --rotation TEXT     Motion tracking box rotation in degrees (required for tracker
                              type 1; use 0 when unrotated)
          --left-up-x TEXT    Surface tracking left-up x in canvas coordinates
          --left-up-y TEXT    Surface tracking left-up y in canvas coordinates
          --left-down-x TEXT  Surface tracking left-down x in canvas coordinates
          --left-down-y TEXT  Surface tracking left-down y in canvas coordinates
          --right-up-x TEXT   Surface tracking right-up x in canvas coordinates
          --right-up-y TEXT   Surface tracking right-up y in canvas coordinates
          --right-down-x TEXT Surface tracking right-down x in canvas coordinates
          --right-down-y TEXT Surface tracking right-down y in canvas coordinates
          --content-u-min TEXT 
                              Follower left edge in tracked-plane coordinates (seed plane is
                              0..1; may be outside)
          --content-u-max TEXT 
                              Follower right edge in tracked-plane coordinates (seed plane is
                              0..1; may be outside)
          --content-v-min TEXT 
                              Follower top edge in tracked-plane coordinates (seed plane is
                              0..1; may be outside)
          --content-v-max TEXT 
                              Follower bottom edge in tracked-plane coordinates (seed plane is
                              0..1; may be outside)
          --surface-name TEXT Surface tracking plane name
          --second-edit-media-time <duration> 
                              Surface second-edit media time; explicit unit required: us, ms,
                              s, or min
          --coordinate-space TEXT 
                              Tracking coordinates: canvas (default), target-local (motion), or
                              video-normalized (surface)
          --config-path TEXT  Algorithm config directory
          --mode TEXT         Tracking direction / mode
          --tracking-time-range TEXT 
                              Tracking time range flag
          --begin-time <duration> 
                              Tracking begin time; explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or min
          --end-time <duration> 
                              Tracking end time; explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or min
          --start-time <duration> 
                              Initial tracking seed frame; explicit unit required: us, ms, s,
                              or min; defaults to --begin-time
          --wait TEXT         Wait for tracking to finish: true / false
          --timeout <duration> 
                              Caller-side wait timeout with explicit unit; the background task
                              continues after timeout
          --poll-interval <duration> 
                              Task status poll interval; explicit unit required (us, ms, s,
                              min)
          --enable-scale      Enable scale tracking
          --enable-relative-distance 
                              Enable relative distance tracking
          --commit-immediately 
                              Commit tracking data immediately
          --extension-json TEXT 
                              Provider extension JSON object or @path; keys are lowered under
                              extra.*
          --output-track-data Return normalized tracking samples in the command result
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  # Track a moving target using explicit options
  $ lyra-cli draft algo video-tracking \
      --source-seg-id <VIDEO_UUID> --seg-id <FOLLOWER_UUID> \
      --center-x 0.5 --center-y 0.5 --width 0.3 --height 0.3 --rotation 0
  # Submit perspective surface tracking and query the returned task_id
  $ lyra-cli draft algo video-tracking --tracker-type 2 --wait false \
      --source-seg-id <VIDEO_UUID> --seg-id <FOLLOWER_UUID> \
      --left-up-x=-0.2 --left-up-y=0.2 --left-down-x=-0.2 --left-down-y=-0.2 \
      --right-up-x=0.2 --right-up-y=0.2 --right-down-x=0.2 --right-down-y=-0.2 \
      --content-u-min=0.05 --content-u-max=0.95 --content-v-min=0.36 --content-v-max=0.54
  $ lyra-cli draft algo query --task-id <task_id>
  # Pass provider extension data as a structured object
  $ lyra-cli draft algo video-tracking --source-seg-id <VIDEO_UUID> \
      --seg-id <FOLLOWER_UUID> --extension-json '{"debug":1}'
